activation.details: Installation and explicit replacement of the built-in widget would be separate user-approved actions.

payload.effects: If separately reviewed, installed, and enabled, this unsandboxed third-party widget replaces the built-in workspace bar widget and changes how focused and displayed workspaces are presented across monitors.
payload.explanation: Reference the exact MIT-licensed marketplace snapshot of dzanaga's Multi-monitor Workspaces Indicator. It declares itself a clone of omarchy.workspaces and is an optional alternative to a built-in widget, not an upstream fix.

reference.source_description: MIT-licensed snapshot by dzanaga; official marketplace listing snapshot

payload.rollback: Disable and remove the third-party plugin so the built-in omarchy.workspaces widget can be restored. Confirm the prior bar configuration after rollback.
payload.validation_plan: In a disposable multi-monitor Omarchy environment, review the exact pinned source, verify focus versus displayed-workspace states on each monitor, move workspaces between monitors, check single-monitor fallback, restart the shell, and confirm rollback to the built-in widget. No such test was performed for this record.
